description: `DocAccess` and the boundaries above it catch `Forbidden`, `Unauthorized` and `RpcClientError`. `GetDoc` can also fail with `DocNotFound`, so reading through `useDocAccess`, which returns the data itself, doesn't type-check, and the error names what's left. `DocAccess.useResult` hands it back instead.

errors.message:
Argument of type 'QueryHandle<(input: { readonly id: number; }) => QueryOptions<Flat<{ data: { readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }; key: readonly ["docs", number]; } & { error: DocNotFound | Forbidden | RpcClientError | Unauthorized; } & { ...; }>>>' is not assignable to parameter of type 'QueryHandle<(input: { readonly id: number; }) => QueryOptions<Flat<{ data: { readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }; key: readonly ["docs", number]; } & { error: DocNotFound | ... 2 more ... | Unauthorized; } & { ...; }>>> & { ...; }'.
  Property 'UnhandledErrors' is missing in type 'QueryHandle<(input: { readonly id: number; }) => QueryOptions<Flat<{ data: { readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }; key: readonly ["docs", number]; } & { error: DocNotFound | Forbidden | RpcClientError | Unauthorized; } & { ...; }>>>' but required in type '{ readonly UnhandledErrors: "DocNotFound"; }'.

title: No data until every error is handled

description: Read through `Session`, a doc can still fail with `Forbidden` or `DocNotFound`: both come back in the `Result`. Forgetting one is a type error that names it.

errors.message:
Argument of type '{ DocNotFound: () => React.JSX.Element; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ValueTagHandlers<DocNotFound | Forbidden> & {}'.
  Property 'Forbidden' is missing in type '{ DocNotFound: () => React.JSX.Element; }' but required in type 'ValueTagHandlers<DocNotFound | Forbidden>'.

title: What's left must be matched exhaustively

description: Under `DocAccess`, the failure is `DocNotFound` and nothing else. An `Unauthorized` can't reach this component (`Session` caught it), so a case for it is a type error, not dead code.

errors.message: Type '() => React.JSX.Element' is not assignable to type 'never'.

title: You can't handle an error a boundary already caught

description: `Session` already catches `Unauthorized`, so a boundary inside it that lists `Unauthorized` again would never see one.

errors.message:
Type '[typeof Unauthorized]' is not assignable to type 'readonly [typeof Unauthorized] & { readonly AlreadyHandledAbove: "Unauthorized"; }'.
  Property 'AlreadyHandledAbove' is missing in type '[typeof Unauthorized]' but required in type '{ readonly AlreadyHandledAbove: "Unauthorized"; }'.

title: A boundary can't catch what one above it catches

description: `useRun()` runs an Effect with the client's services. Called directly, it resolves with the success, so it only type-checks when the chain catches everything: `RenameDoc` can also fail with `DocNotFound` and `EmptyTitle`. `run.result` hands those back in a `Result`.

errors.message:
Argument of type 'Effect<{ readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }, DocNotFound | EmptyTitle | Forbidden | RpcClientError | Unauthorized, DocsClient | QueryCache>' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Effect<{ readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }, DocNotFound | EmptyTitle | Forbidden | RpcClientError | Unauthorized, DocsClient | QueryCache> & { ...; }'.
  Property 'UnhandledErrors' is missing in type 'Effect<{ readonly body: string; readonly id: number; readonly title: string; readonly updatedBy: string; }, DocNotFound | EmptyTitle | Forbidden | RpcClientError | Unauthorized, DocsClient | QueryCache>' but required in type '{ readonly UnhandledErrors: "DocNotFound" | "EmptyTitle"; }'.

title: An action's errors are checked the same way

description: The client is built from the RPC client's layer. An Effect that needs another service (`Analytics` here) can't be run under any boundary of that client.

title: An Effect can only use services the client provides

description: A boundary that catches `DocNotFound` too leaves nothing, so its hook returns the doc itself: no `Result`, nothing to match. `useSession` on the doc list is the same: `Session` and the boundaries above it catch everything `ListDocs` can fail with. This file compiles.
title: Once every error is caught, there is no failure to get
